title: The Magical Eye
summary: Without it, the Evoker has no power. Where: evokers and woodland mansions.

goals.say: The Magical Eye stares back at you. (It goes back in your pack.)
goals.name: Magical Eye (given back)

quest_book.title: Twelve Eyes
quest_book.author: The Librarian
pages: Ordinary eyes of ender will not open this gate any more. The frames want older eyes, sixteen kinds, scattered across the world.
You take the overworld. I've marked the rest on this page: the Nether, the dead, and the crafted ones. Twelve should open it.
